title: 第25章
content:
陆菲青连忙对着方言说道：“方少侠不必担心，文大侠伉俪二人暂且无事，他们已经和我师侄余鱼同汇合，安全暂时无虞。并且我已经修书一封去往铁胆庄，请周庄主庇护一二，我则是前往安西镇，寻找红花会的好汉前去相救。没成想半路上先遇见了你！”方言连忙抱拳道谢：“多谢陆老先生回护之恩！”陆菲青闻言，奇怪的问道：“咦，我并未对方少侠报出名号，方少侠是如何知道老夫姓陆的？”方言笑道：“方才陆老先生已经说了！您称呼红花会的十四当家，‘金笛秀才’余鱼同为师侄，余大哥师承武当掌门马道长，想必您就是武当‘绵里针’陆菲青陆老先生了！”陆菲青赞道：“好敏锐的心思！红花会有你这等少年英杰，大事可期！”方言笑道：“陆大侠谬赞了！原本小子应当做东，好好感谢一下陆老先生，但是我文四哥和骆嫂嫂还身处危险之中，须得赶去支援一二，陆大侠对我文四哥夫妇的救命之恩，容小子日后再报！”陆菲青连忙道：“莫说这些莫说这些，方少侠你快些去吧，他们夫妇二人此时应该已经到了铁胆庄，沿着官道向西百十里就是了！”方言闻言，再次向陆菲青抱拳道谢，随后调转马头，呼喝一声，朝着西方疾驰而去！李沅芷此时愣愣的望着方言离去的背影，眼神中带着一丝好奇和倾慕。“丫头，丫头！”陆菲青低声唤道，“人都走远了，别再看了！”李沅芷闻言一震，瞬间羞红了脸庞，低头道：“我.....我没有......”陆菲青捂着自己的胡须，眼神中全是宠溺的笑意，对着李沅芷调笑道：“哈哈哈，丫头，我和红花会还有些交情，过几日我碰到红花会其他当家的时候，要不要我帮你和方少侠从中撮合一下？”李沅芷被陆菲青看破了心意，一时间又羞又恼，轻轻啐了一口：“师父，你也不羞！”陆菲青哈哈大笑：“哈哈哈哈哈，师父才不羞，我看那方少侠丰神俊朗，一表人才，义薄云天，端的是一桩好姻缘！”“师父~~~~~”李沅芷娇嗔道，打马跑到前面，“我不理你了！”此时他们二人口中的方言，正沿着官道快速疾驰！又不惜马力的奔袭了一个时辰，方言看着座下骏马已经喘不上气，呼哧呼哧喷着唾沫，这才暗叹一声，放缓了马速。长途奔袭的骏马，不能立即停下来，否则立刻就会血管暴裂而死，必须先小跑一会儿，散去体内的热气才行。方言不轻不重的勒着缰绳，任由马儿自己随着心意小跑。又是一炷香的功夫，在路上看见了四骑，当先一人白须飘动，一手拽着缰绳，一手托着两枚铁胆。方言心中一动，连忙高声呼道：“可是‘铁胆’周老英雄当面？”那人闻言，循声望来，见到是一个弱冠之龄的俊秀青年，心中疑惑：“不知少侠是？”方言立即抱拳道：“我是方言，我四哥是‘奔雷手’文泰来，他们夫妇二人正在贵庄养伤！”那老者正是铁胆庄庄主周仲英，闻言大喜道：“好，文大侠此刻就在我庄中，我刚好请了大夫来，少侠你与我一同回去吧！”

方言策马来到他身边，道谢道：“多谢庄主！”和周仲英同行了数里之后，迎面遇见了两骑，一男一女。那女子神色仓惶，脸上犹有泪珠，伤心之色溢于言表。方言见到后，立刻高声喊道：“骆嫂子！”那女子正是骆冰，她身旁的男子年纪稍微轻一些，正是“金笛秀才”余鱼同。“方言！”骆冰听到方言的声音大喜过望，立刻抬头看来，却又看见方言旁边的铁胆庄庄主周仲英，心下恨极，当即就是一把飞刀甩了过来。周仲英见到飞刀奔着自己的面门而来，大吃一惊，仓促之下毫无防备，立刻俯身趴在马上。方言瞳孔微缩，只听得仓啷一声，白光一闪。又是当的一声，骆冰的飞刀被方言长剑磕飞。“嫂子，为何突下辣手？这其中是不是有什么误会？”方言见到周仲英和他的弟子面色不善，连忙开口找补。骆冰闻言大哭道：“文四哥被这沽名钓誉、狼心狗肺的老贼给害啦！！！！”说罢，就挥舞着双刀，朝着周仲英扑来。周仲英的弟子安健刚见到她辱骂自己的师父，现在还想对师父动手，早就按耐不住，拔出单刀就迎了上去。方言见到骆冰的双刀舞得不成章法，恐她吃了亏，连忙用力一蹬马镫，整个人如同大鸟一般飞了出去。先是用剑格开安建刚的单刀，再是用剑鞘架住骆冰的双刀，双手同时使了个巧劲一震，两人手中的武器就不受控制的飞了出去。一切都发生在电光火石间，众人只觉得眼前一花，就看见两人的武器倒飞上天空。“有话好说！”这时候，周仲英阻拦的话才姗姗来迟。“嫂子，要打要杀的也不急于一时，还是先把话说清楚了吧！”方言劝道。骆冰此刻刚逢剧变，心下大乱，哪里听得进去方言的话？之间她哭着调转马头，俯身抄起被打落的双刀，口中犹自怒骂不休：“方言你这个狼心狗肺的东西，文四哥和我待你如何？你如今却帮着外人来对付我？”骂完，也不等方言解释，策马就朝着方言来时的方向跑去。余鱼同恶狠狠的看了一眼方言，掉转马头，一口唾沫恨恨的吐在地下，拍马而走，朝着骆冰追去。方言此时站在地上，一头雾水，不知道发生了何事。过了一会儿，想到周仲英还在原地，方言也只能放下疑惑，转身朝着周仲英和安建刚抱拳致歉：“适才情况紧急，小子不得已出手，多有得罪，还望海涵！”周仲英连忙摆手：“方少侠说的哪里话？刚才若不是少侠，恐怕我和劣徒俱要丧命于此！”
content_en:
Lu Feiqing hurriedly said to Fang Yan: "Young Master Fang, don't worry. Wen Daxia and his wife are fine for the time being. They have reunited with my nephew Yu Yutong and are safe for the time being. And I have already written a letter to go to Tiedan Manor, asking Master Zhou to protect him. I am going to Anxi Town to find the heroes of the Red Flower Club to rescue me. I didn't expect to meet you on the way!" Fang Yan said repeatedly.He hurriedly cupped his fists and thanked: "Thank you, Mr. Lu, for your kindness!" Lu Feiqing heard this and asked strangely: "Hey, I didn't tell Mr. Fang my name. How did Mr. Fang know that my surname is Lu?" Fang Yan said with a smile: "Mr. Lu just said it! You call the fourteenth leader of the Red Flower Society, the 'Golden Flute Scholar' Yu Yutong is your nephew. Brother Yu learned from Wu and became the leader of the martial arts, Taoist Master Ma. I want toYou must be Mr. Lu Feiqing, the "Mianli Zhen" of Wudang!" Lu Feiqing praised: "What a keen mind!Great things can be expected from a young hero like you in Honghua!" Fang Yan said with a smile: "I should be the host and thank Mr. Lu, but my fourth brother Wen and Sister-in-law Luo are still in danger, so we have to rush to help.I will repay you for your life-saving grace to my fourth brother Wen and his wife later!" Lu Feiqing said quickly: "Don't talk about this, Young Master Fang, please go quickly.The couple should have arrived at Tiedan Village by now, just a hundred miles west along the official road!" After hearing this, Fang Yan thanked Lu Feiqing again, then turned his horse's head, shouted, and galloped towards the west!Li Yunzhi stared blankly at Fang Yan's leaving figure, with a hint of curiosity and admiration in his eyes."Girl, girl!" Lu Feiqing called in a low voice, "Everyone has gone away, don't look anymore!" Li Yuanzhi was shocked when she heard this, and her face turned red with embarrassment. She lowered her head and said, "I...I didn't..." Lu Feiqing covered herself.With a beard and a doting smile in his eyes, he teased Li Yuanzhi and said: "Hahaha, girl, I still have some friendship with the Red Flower Club. When I meet the other heads of the Red Flower Club in a few days, do you want me to help you and Fang Shaoxia get involved?"For a moment?"Li Yuanzhi was embarrassed and annoyed for a moment as Lu Feiqing saw through it, and lightly spat: "Master, you are not ashamed either!"Lu Feiqing laughed loudly: "Hahahahaha, Master is not shy. I see that Fang Shaoxia is so handsome., a talented person with a lot of righteousness, it is a good marriage!" "Master~~~~~" Li Yuanzhi said with a smile, and ran to the front, "I will ignore you!" At this time, the dialect spoken by the two of them was galloping along the official road!After running for an hour without hesitation, Fang Yan saw that the horse under him was out of breath, huffing and spitting, and then he sighed secretly and slowed down the horse.A horse running for a long distance cannot stop immediately, otherwise its blood vessels will burst and die immediately. It must first trot for a while to dissipate the heat in the body.Fang Yan tightened the reins gently and let the horse trot as he pleased.After another stick of incense, I saw four riders on the road. The first one had a white beard fluttering, holding the reins in one hand and holding two iron galls in the other.Fang Yan's heart was moved, and he shouted loudly: "But Iron Gale, Old Hero Zhou, in person?" The man heard the words, followed the reputation, and saw a handsome young man of a young age, and wondered in his heart: "I wonder who the young hero is?" Fang Yan immediately clasped his fists and said, "I am Fang Yan,My fourth brother is "Thunder Hand" Wen Tailai, and the couple are recuperating in your village!" The old man was Zhou Zhongying, the owner of Tiedan Village. Hearing this, he said happily: "Okay, Master Wen is in my village at the moment.I just invited the doctor to come. Young Master, please go back with me!"

Fang Yan rode his horse to his side and thanked him: "Thank you, owner!" After walking with Zhou Zhongying for several miles, he met two riders, a man and a woman.The woman looked panicked, with tears on her face, and her sadness was palpable.When Fang Yan saw her, he immediately shouted loudly: "Sister-in-law Luo!" The woman was Luo Bing, and the man beside her was slightly younger, and it was Yu Yutong, the "Golden Flute Scholar"."Fang Yan!" Luo Bing was overjoyed when he heard Fang Yan's voice. He immediately looked up and saw Zhou Zhongying, the owner of Tiedan Village next to Fang Yan. He felt extremely hateful and threw a flying knife at him.Zhou Zhongying was shocked when he saw the flying knife coming towards his face. In his haste, he was unprepared and immediately leaned on his horse.Fang Yan's pupils shrank, and there was only a clanging sound and a flash of white light.There was another clang, and Luo Bing's flying knife was knocked away by Fang Yan's sword."Sister-in-law, why did you suddenly attack? Is there any misunderstanding?" Fang Yan saw Zhou Zhongying and his disciples looking unkind, and quickly opened his mouth to make amends.Luo Bing cried loudly when he heard this: "Brother Wen was harmed by this old thief who was just fishing for fame and reputation!!!!" After saying that, he waved his two swords and rushed towards Zhou Zhongying.An Jiang, Zhou Zhongying's disciple, had just seen her insulting his master, and now she wanted to attack her master. He couldn't hold himself back for a long time, so he drew his single sword and faced her.When Fang Yan saw Luo Bing's swords dancing in an unorganized manner, he was afraid that she would suffer a loss, so he quickly kicked off his stirrups and flew out like a big bird.First, he used his sword to block An Jiangang's single sword, and then used his scabbard to hold Luo Bing's double sword. With a clever shake of his hands at the same time, the weapons in their hands flew out uncontrollably.Everything happened in a flash of lightning, and everyone's eyes were blurred as they saw the weapons of the two men flying upside down into the sky."You have something to say!" At this time, Zhou Zhongying's words to stop him came belatedly."Sister-in-law, if you want to kill someone, don't be in a hurry. It's better to speak clearly first!" Fang Yan advised.Luo Bing had just experienced a drastic change and was in a state of confusion. How could he listen to the dialect?In the meantime, she turned the horse's head while crying, leaned down to pick up the two knocked down knives, and continued to curse in her mouth: "Fang Yan, you are such a wolf-hearted thing, how have Brother Wen and I treated you? Now you are helping outsiders deal with me?" After scolding, without waiting for Fang Yan's explanation, she spurred her horse and ran in the direction where Fang Yan came from.Yu Yutong glanced at Fang Yan fiercely, turned his horse's head, spat on the ground angrily, slapped the horse and ran away, chasing Luo Bing.Fang Yan stood on the ground at this time, confused, not knowing what happened.After a while, thinking that Zhou Zhongying was still there, Fang Yan could only put aside his doubts, turned around and clasped his fists at Zhou Zhongying and An Jiangang and apologized: "The situation was urgent just now, and I had no choice but to take action. I offended you, but I hope Haihan!" Zhou Zhongying waved his hands quickly: "What did Young Master Fang say? If it hadn't been for Young Hero just now, I am afraid that both the scoundrel and I would have died here!"
